note: Actual prompts and input/output checksums are preserved. The recipe checksum identifies the packaged v1 recipe; historical calls did not attest execution of this exact recipe hash. Original images are not bundled. Only approved selected examples are compressed and published; all other attempts remain audit records.

images.prompt: Natural product photograph of one simple unbranded articulated desk lamp on a muted blue-gray desk. Two straight arms connect a circular base to a shallow conical shade angled down left. One closed blank notepad lies at lower right. Diffuse daylight, plain off-white wall, eye-level three-quarter view, entire lamp visible. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.

review.reason: Independently inspected complete articulated lamp: two straight arms, three circular pivots, conical shade with visible bulb, round base and both cable segments are coherent. One blank notebook lies separately on the desk; no brands or text.

images.actual_source_analysis: One light gray articulated desk lamp stands on a muted blue-gray desk. A round disc base sits slightly right of center. Two straight rectangular arms form an open angular shape: the lower arm rises toward the upper right joint, and the upper arm slopes toward the shade at upper left. Three round pivot joints are visible, at the base, elbow and shade attachment. One conical shade points down and left, with a bulb visible inside its opening. A short black cable loop curves above the shade and another cable segment passes behind the base. One closed blank cream notebook lies at lower right. All lamp parts are inside the frame against a plain off-white wall.

images.prompt:
Satin brushed aluminum with fine directional abrasion and anisotropic reflections aligned to individual surfaces.
Preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points. Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement. Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
Translate existing solid surfaces into satin brushed aluminum while preserving all component shapes, joints, gaps, and attachments.
Use cool silver, neutral graphite shadows, and soft pearl highlights with minimal color saturation.
Keep straight edges and curved boundaries faithful; do not add bevels, seams, screws, or technical markings.
Align fine brushing with each surface's construction direction; curved parts receive smoothly wrapping grain.
Retain illumination direction and create elongated anisotropic highlights across the brushing, avoiding mirror-like reflections.
Keep original subject count, framing, perspective, placement, and surrounding negative space.
Maintain readable joints and overlapping parts through local reflection changes rather than invented hardware.
Finish with consistent satin roughness and subtle grain; avoid chrome polish, glitter, or heavily scratched distressing.
Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.
Use the supplied photograph as the sole composition reference. Keep the entire source frame, original 4:5 aspect ratio, camera viewpoint, subject scale, and all margins. Produce at least 1024x1280 pixels. Output only the finished image.
Avoid: Added screws, vents, bevels, industrial labels, or extra joints. Mirror chrome, glitter, rust, or coarse scratches. Changed arm count, closed gaps, text, logos, or watermarks.

review.reason: Independent comparison confirms both arms, all three pivot locations, attachment gaps, shade aperture/bulb, cables and base remain connected with the same pose. Fine directional brushing and satin anisotropic reflections follow each surface. Tiny screw-head marks are smoothed, but the three complete joint bodies and functional attachment structure are preserved; this is minor surface simplification rather than lost assembly.
